name: avatar-design
description: Avatar: The Last Airbender inspired elemental design system for Tailwind CSS v4

scripts.build:classic: mkdir -p showcase/dist/fonts && cp src/fonts/*.ttf showcase/dist/fonts/ && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i showcase/main.css -o showcase/dist/output.css --minify && mkdir -p dist/classic && cp -R showcase/index.html showcase/main.js showcase/motion.js showcase/dist dist/classic/
scripts.dev:classic: mkdir -p showcase/dist/fonts && cp src/fonts/*.ttf showcase/dist/fonts/ && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i showcase/main.css -o showcase/dist/output.css --watch

author: Rodney Hu
